_what: The Meta strategy as rules the machine checks. One file. Every rule says whose it is: `meta` = Meta's own published guidance (quote + source in components/creative-diversity/META.md), `ours` = our working rule built on it. audit.py grades each brand's account against this; the card gate grades each new creative.
_ruled: the owner, 2026-10-07: 'this is just the Meta strategy … dial in on our process to make sure that we're hitting all of our points as well as we possibly can and playing to this algo.'

structure.rule: Campaign = the offer. Each offer runs in its own Advantage+ sales campaign, budget on the campaign (CBO). Every ad in it links to that offer's one page.
structure.meta: Advantage+ sales campaigns: 20% lower cost per result on average

structure.rule: Ad set = who the offer goes to: one avatar + one angle (adset_<brand>_<avatar>_<angle>). Few angles will hit; each gets its own ad set so its learning and spend read on their own.
structure.note: With Advantage+ Audience the ad sets share broad targeting, so Meta still finds people through the creative: the ad level carries the match.

structure.rule: 6 to 10 live creatives per ad set; never above 50.
Optimise for purchase value; pixel + Conversions API send Purchase with value.

creative.rule: Every new creative is 3+ moves from the nearest live creative. Inside one ad set the who (avatar) and angle are fixed by the ad set, so the moves come from awareness · format · face · setting · look.
creative.whose: ours (Meta: 'truly different in look, feel, storyline, and message'; no published threshold)

creative.rule: A new creative uses an image or video the Page has not shown.
creative.meta: fatigue counts 'all recent exposures of the ad's image or video, including those from other campaigns from your Page'

creative.rule: Links to the brand's one offer page and carries the core message.
Every 9:16 video has music or voiceover.
Key messages inside the 9:16 safe zone.
Creator content runs as a partnership ad.

assets.rule: Each ad is a flexible ad carrying the creative in several shapes, up to 10 assets.
Each ad set holds at least one image, one video and one 9:16 video with audio.
At least 20% of an ad set's assets are 9:16 video with audio.

budget.rule: Each ad set needs about 50 results a week to exit learning (Meta), so the campaign's daily budget is about 7 × cost per purchase × the number of live ad sets (ours). Below that, the ad sets stay 'learning limited'; add ad sets only as budget allows.

cadence.rule: Read Monday (one Meta pull) · brief to the gaps Tuesday · drop the week's new creatives into the ad set as one batch Thursday, take out what Meta marks creative limited/fatigue · no edits while learning.
cadence.whose: ours (built on Meta's learning phase and fatigue guidance)

offers._where: Each brand's one offer lives in its own folder: brands/<brand>/meta/offer.json (shape: brands/_TEMPLATE/meta/offer.json). A brand listed here overrides it.
